_: How a record of each kind is drawn as a card. `layout` names one of the card layouts (components/Phiegg/KindList.tsx); the rest are that layout's options: `title` and `sub` are templates filled from the record ({name} · {trait}); `tone`, `club`, `world` and `person` name the record's fields that say them; a field named may step through a link (`clubId.tone`); on a row, `mark` names the field whose record is its mark and `aside` is a template for the figure at its end; `flag` is a field that, when set, shows a word (a badge on a tile, the row's end on a row); `path` is the path it opens on when that is not its kind's own; `tick` is how often (ms) its live values move. A tile may also say: `image`, the record's own picture (paths tried in order); `grid`, a floor grid; `badge`, templates for the words on it; `tag`, a path to the values listed under it (`cities.*.name`); `lead`, the look it wears (the first of the record's rows at `of` whose `look` names a look with a picture, in that row's `colour`). `cols` is how many columns its grid has; `slider` makes tile mode a stage: `card` is what the card is told there, `action` and `icon` the button under it. A template's field may step through a link (`{clubId.ticker}`). Any layout may carry parts (components/Phiegg/CardPart.tsx): `figures` (declared fields, or `{ label, value }`), `progress` (`field`, `note`), `tags` (templates, left out when their fields are empty), `act` (what the viewer can do: rsvp, quest, coin), and on a row `date` and `art` in place of the mark. A template may read a record's live values (lib/liveValue.ts) as `{live.<name>}`, and a tile with `face: look` shows the look's own picture; `color` is a field giving the tile's colour. A kind not listed is a row with its title. The page never names a card.
